mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), potentially reducing promethazine metabolism and increasing anticholinergic/CNS depression effects; additive CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased sedation, anticholinergic symptoms, and ataxia; consider dose adjustment of promethazine or alternative antihistamine if CNS depression becomes problematic.
